title: Sleep and circadian health
optional_inputs: Sleep timing, duration, awakenings, schedule, light exposure, snoring, medication and caffeine
indicative_tests: Sleep diary; actigraphy when available; specialist sleep study when indicated
limitations: PVT and sleep sliders do not diagnose a sleep disorder
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Behavioral and mental health
optional_inputs: Mood, anxiety, functioning, duration, stressors, support preferences; sensitive answers private
exam: Private clinician interview and mental status assessment
indicative_tests: Validated instrument only with exact version, scoring and use rights; targeted medical workup when indicated
limitations: A slider or journal cannot diagnose or exclude psychiatric illness
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Headache
optional_inputs: Onset, abruptness, pattern, neurologic and visual symptoms, fever, exposure timing
indicative_tests: Imaging and other targeted tests selected for concerning features; actual contemporaneous cabin exposure data where relevant
limitations: Normal pulse or historical CO2 cannot exclude a dangerous cause
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Heart rhythm
optional_inputs: Palpitations, onset, duration, chest symptoms, fainting, medications
indicative_tests: ECG; ambulatory monitoring for intermittent symptoms; selected electrolytes and thyroid testing
limitations: Pulse rate is not an ECG
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Acute coronary symptoms
optional_inputs: Chest discomfort, associated breathlessness, onset, history
indicative_tests: ECG and serial cardiac troponin in a capable medical setting; further imaging as selected
limitations: Normal wearable readings cannot rule out acute coronary syndrome
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Orthostatic intolerance
optional_inputs: Gravity transition, position-related symptoms, fluids, medication, fainting
exam: Supervised position-related assessment only when gravity and condition permit
indicative_tests: Position-linked BP and pulse; ECG and other cause-directed testing
limitations: No standing test in microgravity; no unsupervised provocative challenge
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Venous thromboembolism
optional_inputs: Unilateral swelling, pain, breathlessness, prior clot, risk factors
indicative_tests: Vascular ultrasound; pulmonary imaging and selected laboratory tests according to clinical pathway
limitations: Symptoms and pulse cannot diagnose or rule out a clot
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Shock and perfusion
optional_inputs: Bleeding, injury, infection, cardiac symptoms, time course
exam: Immediate clinical airway, breathing, circulation and consciousness assessment
indicative_tests: Serial vital signs; ECG, ultrasound, hemoglobin, lactate and other cause-directed tests when available
limitations: Do not wait for tests or repeat readings before urgent human response
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Respiratory infection
optional_inputs: Cough, sputum, fever, breathlessness, contacts, duration
indicative_tests: Temperature and SpO2 as supporting observations; pathogen tests; chest imaging if indicated
limitations: Normal SpO2 does not exclude infection
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Airway or respiratory emergency
optional_inputs: Breathing difficulty, witnessed obstruction, responsiveness, exposure
indicative_tests: Respiratory rate, SpO2, ECG and blood gas or imaging when indicated and available
limitations: Data collection must not delay urgent response
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Allergic presentations
optional_inputs: Exposure, timing, rash, swelling, breathing and circulatory symptoms
indicative_tests: Clinical diagnosis; selected later allergy investigation by clinician
limitations: No deliberate exposure or home challenge to test an allergy
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Toxic exposure
optional_inputs: Agent, route, amount if known, duration, cabin events, co-exposed people
indicative_tests: Agent-specific laboratory testing; co-oximetry for suspected combustion-related CO exposure; environmental measurements
limitations: Ordinary pulse oximetry cannot establish absence of carbon monoxide poisoning
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Pressure and decompression events
optional_inputs: Pressure profile, suit event, EVA timing, symptoms, prior exposure
indicative_tests: Clinical assessment tied to exposure; targeted imaging or physiologic tests for complications
limitations: No single app test excludes decompression illness; no self-provocation
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Radiation exposure
optional_inputs: Dosimeter, event, location, shielding, onset of symptoms
indicative_tests: Dosimetry; CBC with differential and serial assessment as clinically selected; specialist biodosimetry
limitations: Camera and symptom timing alone cannot estimate a reliable absorbed dose
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Thermal illness and burns
optional_inputs: Heat or chemical event, duration, affected area, pain, functional change
exam: Clinical assessment of extent, depth and systemic effects
indicative_tests: Appropriate temperature measurement and cause-directed laboratory tests; photographs only with consent
limitations: Photo is documentation, not an automatic burn-depth diagnosis
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Dust exposure
optional_inputs: Surface/habitat event, route, duration, eye, skin and respiratory symptoms
indicative_tests: Environmental particle measurement if available; eye or respiratory testing as indicated
limitations: Record suspected exposure separately from measured dose
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Digestive symptoms
optional_inputs: Stool frequency/appearance, vomiting, pain, bleeding, meals, fluids, medications
indicative_tests: Targeted stool, blood or endoscopic investigation according to presentation
limitations: A symptom diary cannot exclude serious abdominal disease
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Acute abdominal presentations
optional_inputs: Pain location/onset, vomiting, bowel movements, fever, pregnancy possibility when relevant
indicative_tests: Condition-directed ultrasound/CT and laboratory workup; pregnancy testing when relevant
limitations: No automated abdominal diagnosis from symptom location
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Urinary infection
optional_inputs: Urinary pain, frequency, fever, flank pain, retention, relevant anatomy
indicative_tests: Urinalysis and urine culture; other testing for systemic illness or obstruction
limitations: Urine color alone cannot diagnose infection
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Bladder emptying and continence
optional_inputs: Last void, volumes, urgency, leakage, medications, neurologic symptoms
indicative_tests: Postvoid residual with bladder ultrasound; urinalysis and further evaluation as indicated
limitations: Absence of a bladder scanner remains an assessment gap
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Kidney stones
optional_inputs: Flank pain, urine changes, fever, prior stones, fluid history
indicative_tests: Urine and blood tests; ultrasound or CT as appropriate
limitations: History alone cannot confirm a stone or exclude infected obstruction
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Reproductive and gynecologic health
optional_inputs: Relevant anatomy, bleeding, pain, menstrual history, pregnancy possibility, medications; private
indicative_tests: Pregnancy testing, ultrasound and targeted laboratory or microbiology tests when indicated
limitations: Pregnancy is not a disease; relevance cannot be inferred from gender/name
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Eye symptoms
optional_inputs: Acuity change, pain, flashes/floaters, chemical/trauma exposure, laterality
indicative_tests: Acuity, slit-lamp/fluorescein, fundus, pressure or imaging as condition requires
limitations: Consumer camera is not a substitute for specialist eye equipment
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular changes
optional_inputs: Visual change, near/far difficulty, mission duration, prior eye baseline
indicative_tests: Acuity, refraction, fundus examination, OCT and ocular ultrasound as indicated
limitations: No SANS diagnosis from face video or headache alone
equipment: OCT; fundus camera; eye examination equipment
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Ear, nose and mouth symptoms
optional_inputs: Pain, obstruction, discharge, bleeding, pressure change, hearing or swallowing change
indicative_tests: Condition-directed tests; imaging or specialist review when indicated
limitations: Webcam pictures cannot replace otoscopy or a full examination
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Hearing
optional_inputs: Sudden/gradual change, laterality, tinnitus, noise exposure, baseline
indicative_tests: Calibrated audiometry; tympanometry or other specialist studies if indicated
limitations: Laptop volume is not calibrated audiometry
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Dental
optional_inputs: Tooth/location, pain, swelling, fever, trauma, lost restoration
indicative_tests: Dental imaging and pulp/periodontal assessment as indicated
limitations: Photo intake cannot rule out deep infection
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Skin and superficial wounds
optional_inputs: Site, evolution, itch/pain, fever, contact, wound mechanism
indicative_tests: Swab/culture, fungal testing or biopsy only as indicated
limitations: Images support documentation; no autonomous image diagnosis
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Injury and dislocation
optional_inputs: Mechanism, site, function, bleeding, numbness, timing
indicative_tests: Imaging selected for injury; internal trauma may need ultrasound/CT and labs
limitations: No self-reduction, invasive examination or forced movement instructions
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Possible fracture
optional_inputs: Mechanism, site, function, neurologic symptoms
indicative_tests: X-ray or CT according to site and clinical concern
limitations: No movement challenge to exclude fracture
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Acute neurologic presentations
optional_inputs: Last known well, new weakness, speech/vision change, seizure, trauma, medications
indicative_tests: Glucose, CT/MRI, ECG and cause-directed tests; EEG for selected seizure evaluation
limitations: No normal vital sign or camera reading rules out neurologic emergency
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Neuropathy
optional_inputs: Distribution, onset, compression/exposure, strength and sensory changes
indicative_tests: Selected nerve conduction/EMG, imaging and laboratory tests
limitations: Symptom mapping is not a localization diagnosis
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Motion and vestibular symptoms
optional_inputs: Gravity transition, movement trigger, nausea, hearing change, neurologic symptoms
indicative_tests: Clinical examination; specialist vestibular or imaging tests if indicated
limitations: No fall-risk provocative test; microgravity changes test applicability
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Musculoskeletal pain
optional_inputs: Site, loading, trauma, function, swelling, neurologic symptoms
indicative_tests: Imaging or laboratory studies when indicated; strength measurements with suitable equipment
limitations: Exercise minutes do not measure strength or bone density
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Possible systemic infection
optional_inputs: Infection symptoms, time course, confusion, urine output, relevant history
indicative_tests: Cultures, blood count, lactate, organ-function tests and source-directed investigation
limitations: Do not use a normal temperature or incomplete score to rule out sepsis
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Medication or substance exposure
optional_inputs: Substance, amount/time if known, co-ingestants, responsiveness, breathing
indicative_tests: ECG, glucose, respiratory monitoring and substance-specific tests as appropriate
limitations: Medication log does not establish dose actually taken or toxicity
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Hydration and nutrition
optional_inputs: Intake, losses, appetite, EVA, urine trend, exercise and mass context
indicative_tests: Mass trends with appropriate device; electrolytes, renal function and other selected labs
limitations: Intake diary and urine color cannot independently diagnose dehydration
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Bone health
optional_inputs: Fractures, mission duration, loading exercise, medications and nutrition
indicative_tests: DXA bone mineral density and selected laboratory evaluation
limitations: Exercise adherence cannot establish preserved bone density
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Endocrine and metabolic disorders
optional_inputs: Symptoms, known condition, medication, nutrition, relevant history
indicative_tests: Condition-specific hormones/metabolic tests; glucose or HbA1c as appropriate
limitations: No universal hormone panel or diagnosis from fatigue
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Hematologic disorders
optional_inputs: Bleeding, fatigue, exposures, medication, history
indicative_tests: CBC/differential and cause-directed coagulation, iron or other studies
limitations: Blood count findings require clinical interpretation
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Possible neoplasm
optional_inputs: Organ-specific symptoms, history, duration, relevant screening history
indicative_tests: Organ-specific imaging, endoscopy and/or pathology as indicated
limitations: Do not create a universal cancer screen or tumor-marker battery
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Other renal conditions
optional_inputs: Urine changes, edema, history, medication, fluids
indicative_tests: Renal function, urine studies and imaging selected for condition
limitations: No renal diagnosis from wearable data
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Other cardiovascular conditions
optional_inputs: Symptoms, exertion, history, medication, prior investigations
indicative_tests: ECG, echocardiography, BP or other condition-specific studies
limitations: Single BP reading is not a general cardiovascular diagnosis
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Inflammatory and connective-tissue conditions
optional_inputs: Joint/systemic symptoms, time course and history
indicative_tests: Condition-directed laboratory testing and imaging; selected fluid studies
limitations: No automatic broad autoantibody panel
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Hepatic and biliary disorders
optional_inputs: Pain, jaundice, exposures, medications, history
indicative_tests: Liver chemistry, targeted infection testing and imaging as indicated
limitations: No liver diagnosis from symptoms alone
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Other pulmonary conditions
optional_inputs: Dyspnea, cough, exposure and history
indicative_tests: Spirometry, imaging, blood gas or specific tests as indicated
limitations: SpO2 does not measure ventilation or PaCO2
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Other vascular conditions
optional_inputs: Site, pain/swelling, function, risk factors
indicative_tests: Appropriate vascular imaging and targeted laboratory studies
limitations: No pulse-only exclusion of vascular disease
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Other digestive disorders
optional_inputs: Site, bowel changes, duration, weight/mass trend and history
indicative_tests: Condition-specific blood/stool testing, imaging or endoscopy
limitations: No routine invasive test merely because a condition is in the catalog
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Specialist review / catalog item
optional_inputs: Narrative concern, onset, function and prior relevant reports
exam: Condition-specific clinician assessment to be specified
indicative_tests: No generic test panel: condition-level pathway requires clinical authoring
limitations: Catalog presence establishes coverage for recording and referral only; no diagnostic workflow yet
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Other neurologic conditions
optional_inputs: Present concern, time course, function, relevant history and existing reports
indicative_tests: Clinical neurologic examination; MRI, electrophysiology or targeted laboratory tests according to the suspected condition
limitations: No neurologic diagnosis from symptom mapping or camera vitals
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

title: Supportive and palliative care
optional_inputs: Present concern, time course, function, relevant history and existing reports
indicative_tests: Assessment of symptoms, function, preferences, care goals and support needs; tests only if they would change goal-concordant care
limitations: A care approach, not a disease requiring a screening test
review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol
